component.name: AbraFlexi ClientZone
component.summary: Customer self-service portal for the AbraFlexi accounting system

description.p: AbraFlexi ClientZone is a web-based self-service portal that connects customers directly to their supplier's AbraFlexi accounting system. It allows customers to browse the product catalogue, place orders, view invoices and orders, download PDF documents, and manage their account details — all without requiring direct access to AbraFlexi.

ul.li: Browse and order items from the AbraFlexi price list
View and download issued invoices and orders as PDF or ISDOC
Receive invoices by e-mail directly from the portal
Customer account registration and password management
Shopping cart with configurable order item parameters
Automatic creation of proforma invoices and orders in AbraFlexi upon checkout
Administrator setup form for AbraFlexi connection and portal options

description.p: Modernized to use AbraFlexi (formerly FlexiBee) libraries and Bootstrap 5.

ul.li: Migrated from FlexiPeeHP to AbraFlexi namespace
Upgraded UI from Bootstrap 3 to Bootstrap 5

description.p: Initial stable release with FlexiBee integration.
